authority.scope: bounded metadata stage only; no G2/G3 or data/model execution gate

static_code_review.ast_parse: PASS using the configured project Python; source parsed only, no collector execution
static_code_review.fixed_input_access: ROOT is opened from slash; every directory component is opened relative to a pinned dirfd with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW; leaf uses O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, then fstat regular-file and size checks; read is bounded; before/after size/mtime/ctime and frozen SHA are checked.
static_code_review.path_escape_and_toctou: No lexical user path enters the collector. Directory descriptors pin traversed directories and leaf is opened relative to the pinned parent, removing the v1 ancestor-symlink/path-replacement window for normal filesystem path resolution.
static_code_review.output: Fixed parent directory is reached through dirfd traversal. Existing final path is checked without following symlinks; pending file is O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, bounded to 262144 encoded bytes, written and fsynced; os.link publishes the complete file atomically without overwriting an existing final path; pending name is removed in finally.
static_code_review.walltime: POSIX SIGALRM default termination is armed for 10 seconds; monotonic deadline checks guard reads, parsing/validation, serialization, and output publication.
static_code_review.schema: All JSON roots must be dicts; draft.dataset, decode structure, join aggregate, and cycle-audit nested object are type-checked. DKP values require exact integer 15/15/0 and join values exact 15/15/0 plus receipt_omits_names true. CSV requires named columns, rejects missing/extra row values, and exact 15-cell order.
static_code_review.semantic_partition: Declared args, proposed draft config, and missing effective Namespace remain separate. Aggregate DKP evidence does not become per-cell presence; loader-rule strings remain candidates; valid_cycle_number remains missing; historical HUST_1-8 count is separately labelled.
static_code_review.prohibited_paths: No pickle/joblib/torch.load, binary/archive-member or payload read, project import/AST execution, dynamic run object, model construction, strict load, forward, metrics, fit, or test path is present in the reviewed collector.

qualification_and_operator_boundary.detail: SIGALRM uses SIG_DFL, so process termination bypasses Python finally blocks. The kernel closes process descriptors; the documented pending file may remain and then O_EXCL prevents an automatic rerun. Treat this as fail-closed and preserve the stale pending file for root review rather than deleting or retrying automatically.

If SIGALRM arrives immediately after the atomic hardlink publishes the final receipt, the process may terminate before normal completion output. The spec documents that a receipt can exist in this case. Root must inspect exit status and verify final receipt integrity before accepting it; no inference from a missing success line.

The directory-fd approach prevents symlink traversal and pathname replacement between check and open. A privileged or same-UID concurrent actor able to rename entries in the output directory could still race the pending hardlink name; no such actor or mutation was observed. The bounded stage assumes the project owner controls this directory during its one authorized run.
